# WageTheft.law

> California wage theft lawyers. Unpaid overtime, missed meal and rest breaks, off-the-clock work, late final paychecks, misclassification and PAGA claims, for one worker or a whole crew. Free case review.

WageTheft.law is operated by Centurion Trial Attorneys, APC, a California employment law firm. Attorney responsible: Ryan Stygar. Phone: 1-888-CALL-RYAN.

## Pages
- [About Attorney Ryan Stygar](https://wagetheft.law/about/): WageTheft.law is run by employment attorney Ryan Stygar and Centurion Trial Attorneys, APC, the firm behind SueMyBoss.Law. We represent California employees, never employers.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://wagetheft.law/accessibility/): How WageTheft.law works to be usable by everyone, the accessibility options on this site, and how to get help if something doesn't work for you.
- [California Wage Theft Guides](https://wagetheft.law/articles/): Plain-English guides to California wage law: unpaid overtime, meal and rest breaks, off-the-clock work, final paychecks, misclassification and PAGA.
- [Wage Theft Class Actions and PAGA Claims in California](https://wagetheft.law/class-actions/): When an employer shorts one worker, it usually shorts the whole crew. How California wage class actions and PAGA claims let workers stand together.
- [California Wage Theft FAQ](https://wagetheft.law/faq/): Answers to common questions about unpaid wages in California: overtime, breaks, final pay, deadlines, retaliation, class actions and what a case costs.
- [How a California Wage Theft Case Works](https://wagetheft.law/how-it-works/): What happens after you contact us about unpaid wages: a free case review, a look at your pay records, and a fight to get back what you're owed.
- [California Wage Theft Lawyers | Unpaid Overtime, Breaks & Final Pay | WageTheft.law](https://wagetheft.law/): Shorted on overtime, breaks or your final paycheck? California wage theft lawyers fight for one worker or a whole crew. Free case review.
- [Disclaimer and Privacy](https://wagetheft.law/legal/): Attorney advertising disclaimer and privacy information for WageTheft.law, operated by Centurion Trial Attorneys, APC.
